title: The Best Thread and Matter Smart Blinds
subtitle: Matter-over-Thread shade motors and motorized shades, ranked.
intro: Thread blinds are new, so most have few reviews. We scored the Matter-over-Thread motors and shades on Amazon on rating, review volume, and features: retrofit fit, battery or solar power, and app support.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

No bullet lists what's in the box, so you can't tell whether the remote is included.
The tube size is 38 mm, but the bullets give no battery or charging details.
It has 3.4 stars, the lowest of the Thread motors we found.

buyers_guide.a: A motor kit fits inside a roller shade you already own, if the tube size matches. A complete shade arrives with the motor installed, cut to your window. Measure the tube or window carefully before ordering either.
Thread is low power, so battery motors last months between charges, and Matter over Thread works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. You need a Thread border router.
Most use a built-in rechargeable battery charged over USB-C or by an optional solar panel. Expect a few months per charge depending on how often the shade moves.
